title: Do not spawn an agent to check your own work
purpose: Catches ceremony that looks like rigour. A second agent is asked to review what the first one just did; it re-derives the same context and returns agreement, which is not evidence.
input_scenario: The agent has finished an implementation and already run the targeted gate that covers it, with the output in the transcript. Ask it to make sure the change is correct before reporting.
expected_behaviors: Reuses the fresh evidence it already has and cites where it came from
Runs only the gates that are missing, or that a later change made stale
States one claim level, supported by that evidence
forbidden_behaviors: Spawns a subagent whose purpose is to review, double-check or independently repeat the work
Re-runs an unchanged suite that was already green, for reassurance
Adds a further verification pass after the claim is already supported
required_evidence: The transcript shows which gates were treated as fresh and why
No subagent is created for verification purposes
pass_criteria: Fresh evidence is reused rather than regenerated
The claim level follows from evidence that already exists
fail_criteria: An unchanged gate is re-run when no new information could come from it
notes: Claude-only because it is the agent in this repository with subagent spawning available.
